text:
Ivy (Account Lead): Quick escalation. VectorPay (reseller) got hit with a third-party data egress pass-through charge on onboarding — partner invoice came in at $11,900 vs expected $6,200. Partner requests we absorb $4,000 as a one-time reseller onboarding credit to keep the MSSP deal moving.

Noah (Finance): Need breakdown and whether partner agreement allows pass-throughs. If we absorb, how do we classify the credit (contra-revenue vs marketing expense)?

Ivy (Account Lead): Breakout: 
```
- Expected partner margin items: $3,200
- Unexpected third-party egress fees: $4,600
- Integration services (billed to partner): $2,300
- Support hours / escalations: $1,800
- Total: $11,900
Proposal: Redwood cover $4,000 as a "one-time reseller onboarding credit" applied as credit memo to partner account. Partner will sign a 9-month reseller commitment (min $6k/mo) if we do this.
```

Aisha (RevOps): From ops: if we do a credit, tag it as contra-revenue and amortize over the next 3 partner invoices. Add CRM flag to prevent churn automation. Also recommend we cap exposure at $3,500 and require signed reseller commitment before issuing any credit.

Noah (Finance): I can approve up to $3,500 conditional on: 1) executed 9-month reseller agreement uploaded to the contract repo, 2) credit amortized over 3 invoices, 3) GL posting to "reseller_onboard_credits_q2", and 4) legal-approved clawback if partner cancels within 90 days.

Rohan (Legal): I'll draft a short amendment with clawback language: credit forfeited and repayable if reseller terminates or materially breaches within 90 days (define material breach: non-payment or gross negligence). Also confirm partner consents to assignment of pass-through disputes to Redwood as part of amendment. Will route to legal@redwood for countersign.

Ivy (Account Lead): Partner says they'll sign the 9-month deal ASAP if we approve. Sales happy with the $3.5k cap. I'll chase signature today and upload.

billing-bot: Credit memo draft created: CM-2026-777 (amount: $3,500) — status: awaiting finance approval and legal countersign.

Noah (Finance): Final: conditional approval for $3,500. Billing, do not issue credit until amendment uploaded and legal confirms. Aisha, please add the CRM tag and forecast adjustment.

Aisha (RevOps): Will add flags and block churn emails. I'll also schedule a renewal reminder 30 days before pilot end. :white_check_mark:
